queryLines:
-- (Q01) Overall KPI summary: net revenue, orders, active customers, average order value
-- Recomputed from fact_sales + dims so the global date-range / region / market-segment filters apply.
SELECT
  SUM(fs.extended_price * (1 - fs.discount)) AS net_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fs.order_id) AS total_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fs.customer_id) AS active_customers,
  SUM(fs.extended_price * (1 - fs.discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT fs.order_id) AS average_order_value
FROM
  IDENTIFIER(:catalog_name || '.gold.fact_sales') fs
    JOIN IDENTIFIER(:catalog_name || '.gold.dim_customer') dc
      ON fs.customer_id = dc.customer_id
    JOIN IDENTIFIER(:catalog_name || '.gold.dim_geography') dg
      ON dc.nation_id = dg.nation_id
WHERE
  (
    fs.order_date >= :order_date_range.min
    OR :order_date_range.min IS NULL
  )
  AND (
    fs.order_date <= :order_date_range.max
    OR :order_date_range.max IS NULL
  )
  AND (
    :region IS NULL
    OR array_contains(:region, dg.region_name)
  )
  AND (
    :market_segment IS NULL
    OR array_contains(:market_segment, dc.market_segment)

-- (Q03) Annual revenue with year-over-year change
-- Recomputed from fact_sales + dims so the global date-range / region / market-segment filters apply.
WITH annual AS (
  SELECT
    YEAR(fs.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(fs.extended_price * (1 - fs.discount)) AS net_revenue
  FROM
    IDENTIFIER(:catalog_name || '.gold.fact_sales') fs
      JOIN IDENTIFIER(:catalog_name || '.gold.dim_customer') dc
        ON fs.customer_id = dc.customer_id
      JOIN IDENTIFIER(:catalog_name || '.gold.dim_geography') dg
        ON dc.nation_id = dg.nation_id
  WHERE
    (
      fs.order_date >= :order_date_range.min
      OR :order_date_range.min IS NULL
    )
    AND (
      fs.order_date <= :order_date_range.max
      OR :order_date_range.max IS NULL
    )
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR array_contains(:region, dg.region_name)
    )
    AND (
      :market_segment IS NULL
      OR array_contains(:market_segment, dc.market_segment)
    )
  GROUP BY
    YEAR(fs.order_date)
)
SELECT
  order_year,
  net_revenue,
  LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_year) AS prior_year,
  net_revenue - LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_year) AS change_vs_prior,
  ROUND(
    100
      * (net_revenue - LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_year))
      / LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_year),
    2
  ) AS yoy_pct_change
FROM
  annual
ORDER BY
  order_year;

      ON fs.customer_id = dc.customer_id
    JOIN IDENTIFIER(:catalog_name || '.gold.dim_geography') dg
      ON dc.nation_id = dg.nation_id
WHERE
  (
    fs.order_date >= :order_date_range.min

  AND (

datasets.name: 5d0d1494
queryLines:
-- (Q16) Average shipping time (receipt to order) by shipping mode
-- Supports the global date-range / region / market-segment filters.
SELECT
  fs.ship_mode,
  ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(fs.receipt_date, fs.order_date)), 2) AS avg_shipping_days,
  COUNT(*) AS shipment_count
FROM
  IDENTIFIER(:catalog_name || '.gold.fact_sales') fs
    JOIN IDENTIFIER(:catalog_name || '.gold.dim_customer') dc
      ON fs.customer_id = dc.customer_id
    JOIN IDENTIFIER(:catalog_name || '.gold.dim_geography') dg
      ON dc.nation_id = dg.nation_id
WHERE
  fs.receipt_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    fs.order_date >= :order_date_range.min
    OR :order_date_range.min IS NULL
  )
  AND (
    fs.order_date <= :order_date_range.max
    OR :order_date_range.max IS NULL
  )
  AND (
    :region IS NULL
    OR array_contains(:region, dg.region_name)
  )
  AND (
    :market_segment IS NULL
    OR array_contains(:market_segment, dc.market_segment)
  )
GROUP BY
  fs.ship_mode
ORDER BY
  avg_shipping_days DESC;

datasets.name: db082ffd
queryLines:
-- (Q21) Supplier revenue concentration: cumulative share of top suppliers
-- Supports the global date-range / region / market-segment filters.
WITH supplier_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    ds.supplier_id,
    ds.supplier_name,
    SUM(fs.extended_price * (1 - fs.discount)) AS net_revenue
  FROM
    IDENTIFIER(:catalog_name || '.gold.fact_sales') fs
      JOIN IDENTIFIER(:catalog_name || '.gold.dim_supplier') ds
        ON fs.supplier_id = ds.supplier_id
      JOIN IDENTIFIER(:catalog_name || '.gold.dim_customer') dc
        ON fs.customer_id = dc.customer_id
      JOIN IDENTIFIER(:catalog_name || '.gold.dim_geography') dg
        ON dc.nation_id = dg.nation_id
  WHERE
    (
      fs.order_date >= :order_date_range.min
      OR :order_date_range.min IS NULL
    )
    AND (
      fs.order_date <= :order_date_range.max
      OR :order_date_range.max IS NULL
    )
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR array_contains(:region, dg.region_name)
    )
    AND (
      :market_segment IS NULL
      OR array_contains(:market_segment, dc.market_segment)
    )
  GROUP BY
    ds.supplier_id,
    ds.supplier_name
),
supplier_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    supplier_id,
    supplier_name,
    net_revenue,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY net_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank,
    SUM(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY net_revenue DESC) AS cumulative_revenue,
    SUM(net_revenue) OVER () AS total_revenue
  FROM
    supplier_revenue
)
SELECT
  supplier_id,
  supplier_name,
  ROUND(net_revenue, 2) AS net_revenue,
  ROUND(100.0 * net_revenue / total_revenue, 4) AS supplier_share_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * cumulative_revenue / total_revenue, 4) AS cumulative_share_pct
FROM
  supplier_ranked
ORDER BY
  revenue_rank
LIMIT 20;
